g.text: validate token + hold SOME registry:admin-shaped scope
(coarse ASP.NET Core policy, ahead of the handler)
[valid token, no registry:admin-shaped scope at all]
ok (caller's own scope claim; AppId itself is never
derived from it -- the caller must still assert it in the body)

[caller's scope doesn't cover this request's AppId]
validate jsonSchema is well-formed JSON Schema
validate each filterableFields[].jsonPath resolves in jsonSchema

validate entityIdField is present (ADR-021 -- no default, 400 if missing)
parse expression list, validate every alias
names a real property of this version's schema
determine version = active version for (AppId, Name) + 1 (or 1 if new)
INSERT EventTypeDefinition (AppId, Name, Version, ...), FilterableField rows
CREATE INDEX / ALTER TABLE ... ADD computed column + index
mark new (AppId, Name) version IsActive = true, prior version IsActive = false
invalidate OpenAPI cache and this AppId's GraphQL SDL cache (ADR-002, ADR-037)
